news.urls

URL routes for the HTML pages of the news app.

These routes are included at the site root by news_application/urls.py, which also adds /admin/, /login/, /logout/, and /api/.

Path

Name

View

/

home

news.views.home()

/register/

register

news.views.register()

/articles/<pk>/

article_detail

news.views.article_detail()

/articles/new/

article_create

news.views.article_create()

/articles/<pk>/edit/

article_edit

news.views.article_edit()

/articles/<pk>/delete/

article_delete

news.views.article_delete()

/editor/review/

review_articles

news.views.review_articles()

/editor/articles/<pk>/approve/

approve_article

news.views.approve_article()

/newsletters/

newsletter_list

news.views.newsletter_list()

/newsletters/new/

newsletter_create

news.views.newsletter_create()

/newsletters/<pk>/edit/

newsletter_edit

news.views.newsletter_edit()

/newsletters/<pk>/delete/

newsletter_delete

news.views.newsletter_delete()

/subscriptions/

subscriptions

news.views.subscriptions()
